file_spec.value: Two copies required. Photographs must not be mounted; must be printed on normal thin photographic paper and must not be glazed on the reverse side. One copy must be endorsed on the reverse by a qualifying witness with 'I certify that this is a true likeness of the applicant...' and signed.

face_visibility.value: Photograph must be taken full face (front-facing view).

headwear_policy.value: Photograph must be taken without a hat. No religious or medical exception is stated anywhere in the regulation text.

headwear.en: The photograph must be taken full face without a hat (no religious or medical exception is stated in the regulation text).
headwear.ko: 사진은 모자를 쓰지 않은 정면 얼굴로 촬영해야 한다 (규정 원문에 종교적·의료적 예외 조항은 명시되어 있지 않다).
headwear.ja: 写真は帽子を着用せず正面から撮影しなければならない(規定原文に宗教上・医療上の例外規定の記載はない)。

face_visibility.en: The photograph must be taken full face (front-facing view).
face_visibility.ko: 사진은 정면 얼굴(정면 응시)로 촬영해야 한다.
face_visibility.ja: 写真は正面向き(顔全体が見える正面)で撮影しなければならない。

db_conflicts.research_value: 2 inches x 1½ inches (≈50.8mm x 38.1mm) per the official Passports Regulations (CAP. 24.20.1, 2022 Revised Edition) — a different, larger, and differently-proportioned size than the DB's 35x45mm.

cross_verification.note_en: Retrieved directly via curl + pdftotext (WebFetch could not parse this 38-page PDF's binary stream) from tuvalu-legislation.tv, Tuvalu's official legislation portal, hosting CAP. 24.20.1 Passports Regulations, 2022 Revised Edition. The regulation's Schedule 1 forms restate this '2 inches by 1½ inches' size multiple times (adult, child, and investor-immigrant applications) with high internal consistency. No background colour, head-height, expression, or glasses rule is specified anywhere in the regulation text — full-text review found only quantity (2 copies), size, mounting/paper, and 'full face without hat'. A secondary source (Tuvalu High Commission NZ site, tuvaluhc.org.nz/passports) reportedly states a white background and bans t-shirts/vests/earrings/necklaces/jackets per search-engine synthesis, but this page is a JavaScript single-page app with an expired/invalid TLS certificate that could not be independently rendered or verified by direct fetch in this session, so it was excluded from verified fields per the truth gate.
